animalLookup.title: Find an animal by its ID card
animalLookup.hint: Type the number printed on the animal's ID card. You can open an animal only if its owner has booked you, shared it with your hospital, or given you consent.
animalLookup.label: ID card number
animalLookup.readOnly: You can read this animal's records but not change them. Ask the owner to give you permission to add notes or prescriptions.
animalLookup.failed: We could not look this up just now. Check your connection and try again.
